description: Los Angeles-based alternative asset manager co-founded in 1995 by Howard Marks and Bruce Karsh, best known for credit and distressed-debt investing. Brookfield, a partner since 2019, completed acquisition of the remaining ~26% it did not own for ~$3.0B on July 31, 2026, taking 100% ownership and forming a ~$365B combined credit platform.

Sydney-based AI infrastructure company building Nvidia-architecture 'AI factories' with proprietary immersion-cooling and grid-aware technology across Australia and Asia-Pacific (Project Southgate rollout, Indonesia next). Raised a fully subscribed $2B strategic equity round from Blackstone, Coatue, Nvidia and Jane Street at a post-money valuation above $10.5B.

Alameda, CA battery-materials company (founded 2011 by ex-Tesla engineer Gene Berdichevsky) making silicon-carbon anodes at its Moses Lake, WA plant. Received a conditional loan commitment of up to $1.4B from the Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital to expand anode capacity and build a lithium-ion cell facility for defense supply chains (satellites, UAS, munitions).

Live-shopping marketplace (founded 2019, CEO Grant LaFontaine) where sellers broadcast live shows to sell collectibles, fashion and more. Closed a $545M Series G at a $20B valuation — roughly double its Oct 2025 mark — led by ICONIQ, Lightspeed and Avra, with returning backers including Andreessen Horowitz, DST Global and CapitalG; ~$1.5B raised to date.

California aerospace/defense manufacturer (founded 2023 by ex-SpaceX engineers Jordan Black and Benjamin Shanahan) automating wire-harness production with its Amp software platform. Raised a $65M Series B co-led by Lowercarbon Capital and Interlagos — with Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz and Founders Fund participating — to open a third factory; total funding tops $112M.

US critical-minerals venture receiving an $85.5M equity investment from the Department of War's IBAS program (plus $64.5M private co-investment) to build a vertically integrated US supply chain for refractory-grade bauxite — currently import-dependent on China. Funds go in part to acquiring and expanding the First Bauxite mine in Guyana, targeting 100% of US military demand.

A 1.2 GW portfolio of developed solar and onshore-wind assets across Germany, Spain, France and Poland, with an enterprise value of ~€1.8B. KKR (through an insurance account it manages) agreed to acquire a 50% stake; TotalEnergies retains the other 50% and continues operating the assets, part of its farm-down capital-recycling model.

Mobility-infrastructure company founded 2020 by Ladi Delano and Jide Odunsi (now UAE-headquartered) that finances, owns and operates vehicle fleets — ~42,000 vehicles across 29 cities — and runs autonomous-fleet operations, including as a fleet operator for Waymo in Phoenix and Miami. Raised a $250M Series C led by Mubadala at a $2.1B valuation, with Woven Capital (Toyota) and Uber among backers.

target: Kuwait Oil Company Pipeline JV (Project Peregrine)
description: A $16.0B lease-and-leaseback joint venture over Kuwait Oil Company's entire domestic and export crude pipeline network (13 pipelines, ~320 km). A Blackstone/Brookfield/KKR consortium holds 49% (equal shares) with KOC keeping 51%, ownership and operations; the JV leases usage rights back to KOC for 20.5 years for a volume-based tariff, generating ~$7.85B upfront — Kuwait's largest-ever FDI.
